prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Senhor, conduzi os vossos fiéis no caminho da salvação eterna.

meta.face: A Syrian-born bishop of about sixty with a warm olive complexion and a SHORT, WIDE-CHEEKED face under a FLAT, SQUARE forehead — broad, rounded cheekbones set high, a long, straight, narrow nose running down from a low bridge, large, round, wide-open dark eyes under level dark-grey brows, a small, closed mouth; thick, short white hair combed forward in a straight, even fringe low on the forehead, as in the mosaic; a short white beard and moustache narrowing to a neat POINT at the chin; a calm, wide-eyed, frontal gaze.
meta.basis: The apse mosaic of Sant'Apollinare in Classe (c. 549), which we checked, shows him frontal in the orans gesture, with short white hair combed forward, large eyes and a short pointed white beard, between lambs among lilies. The Roman Martyrology's tradition makes him a Syrian, hence the olive complexion; the rest of the structure is our choice.
